title: epipactis helleborine subsp. leptochila
intro: Epipactis helleborine subsp. leptochila, commonly known as the slender helleborine, is a subspecies of orchid native to Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis helleborine subsp. leptochila include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
